title: Brazilian Herbal Tart
description: A flavorful and juicy tart that combines the tastes of Brazil with the freshness of herbs.
instructions: Roll out the shortcrust pastry on a lightly floured surface to a thickness of about 1/8 inch.
Transfer the pastry to a 9-inch tart pan with a removable bottom.
In a small bowl, mix together the basil, oregano, coconut oil, sugarcane syrup, lemon juice, and confectioners' sugar until well combined.
Brush the pastry with the herb mixture, making sure to leave a 1-inch border around the edges.
Fold the edges of the pastry up over the filling to create a crust.
Prick the bottom of the pastry with a fork to prevent it from bubbling up during baking.
Bake the tart for 40 minutes, or until the crust is golden brown and the filling is set.
Remove the tart from the oven and let it cool in the pan for 5 minutes.
Transfer the tart to a wire rack to cool completely.
Serve the tart at room temperature, garnished with additional fresh herbs if desired.
